contexts.text: To the Angel of the Church in Sardis write () = to those and concerning those who are in dead worship, or in worship which is devoid of the goods of charity and the truths of faith. Explained. ( = those who lead a moral life, but not a spiritual one, because they have little regard for the Knowledges of spiritual things, and the derivative intelligence and wisdom, AE 182.)

Thou hast a few names even in Sardis, which have not defiled their garments () = those who lead a moral life from a spiritual origin by applying the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word to the uses of their life.
Life according to doctrine is treated of in the things written to the Churches in Thyatira and Sardis.
